NewsJune 16, 2026

BREASTFEEDING IS THE EASIEST CHOICE

Breastfeeding offers immense benefits for both baby and mother. It provides perfect nutrition, antibodies, and DHA for strong immunity, brain development, and emotional bonding, while helping babies develop healthy jaws and teeth. Challenges like sore nipples can be overcome with patience and a positive mindset. It saves families money, helps mothers lose pregnancy weight faster, and burns extra calories daily. Breast size does not limit milk supply — frequent nursing, nutrition, and hydration do. Contrary to fears, breastfeeding does not ruin breast shape more than age or gravity. By Pearl Exornam Selormey, Nutritionist
